question: Which are the two major branches of the southwest monsoon in India?

options.text: The Himalayan Mountain branch and the Gulf of Mannar branch
The Arabian Sea branch and the Bay of Bengal branch
The Arabian Sea branch and the Tibetan plateau branch
The Tibetan plateau branch and the Bay of Bengal branch

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Arabian Sea branch and the Bay of Bengal branch** are the two major branches of the southwest monsoon in India.
 
• The Arabian Sea branch hits the western coast of India, including the states of Kerala, Karnataka, and Maharashtra.
 
• The Bay of Bengal branch moves towards northeastern India and the Gangetic plains, bringing rainfall to states like West Bengal, Bihar, and Ut
